screens.name: 1. Despensa e Alertas de Validade (Dashboard)
screens.prompt: Android native mobile screen Material 3 for 'Chef de Despensa'. Top AppBar with title Chef de Despensa and expiration alert counter. RecyclerView of pantry ingredients with dynamic badges: green for safe, amber for expiring in 3 days, red for expired. Floating action button with + icon to add new ingredient, and button at the bottom to view suggested recipes from expiring items.

screens.name: 2. Cadastro de Ingrediente (Formulário)
screens.prompt: Android native form screen Material 3 for adding a pantry ingredient. Input fields: Nome do Ingrediente (e.g., Leite, Tomate), Quantidade (number with unit selector: kg, g, un, L, ml), Data de Validade with interactive DatePicker calendar button. Primary button at bottom 'Salvar Ingrediente' and cancel button.

screens.name: 3. Sugestões de Receitas (TheMealDB)
screens.prompt: Android mobile recipe suggestion screen. Header 'Receitas com Ingredientes Prestes a Vencer'. Cards showing recipe photo, recipe name, category and ingredients list with button to cook.
